title: Recent Apps credits their makers
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer credit for app makers, a cleaned-up catalog, and fresh README illustrations.

The README’s Recent Apps table now names individual GitHub contributors instead of attributing apps to a generic account.

App listings now credit the right creators. Seven broken or invalid entries were removed, and Flux AI SVG Generator was restored under its creator’s account.

Four illustrations in the header, image-generation example, and supporters section were replaced with consistently sized images hosted on pollinations media.
